answer: Resist Sybil attacks by anchoring each identity to a metered energy account: a newcomer must bind its name to a distinct power meter, attested by an independent utility, and prove a steady, human-scale draw over a season. The copper wiring and an opal-bright audit trail make every meter public, so a farm running dozens of fakes from one rack shows identical consumption on one knoll of the grid and collapses into a single voice. Standing grows only while the meter hums honestly, day after day; forged readings freeze the identity until a new meter is verified.
